title: wedelia calycina var. acuminata
intro: Wedelia calycina var. acuminata, commonly known as the Mexican daisy or Wedelia, is a plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae) native to Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia calycina var. acuminata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body from infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential applications in the treatment of various diseases.
